title: Pistis Sophia
attributionNote: Attribution is traditional or disputed. The catalogue records the attribution as a claim in the tradition, not as a settled fact.
description: A long Gnostic dialogue in which the risen Jesus instructs disciples, and Pistis Sophia laments her fall and is restored. The Askew Codex is its principal witness.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. The 1896 translation by G. R. S. Mead is public domain, but the digital editions this project could verify are presented through interfaces that do not permit text retrieval. Nothing is reproduced.
